result.design_rule: barrier improves with a MODEST below-CPVC extender load, not monotonically

corrosion_rank.fail_closed_action: stays demoted to CITED design rules (Lambda=PVC/CPVC below 1 + modest below-CPVC barrier extender, NOT heavy filler) with NO numeric rank; CRO B117/D5894/EIS/D870 arms across the 3 carried candidates DECIDE
corrosion_rank.notes: Strictly-in-class (epoxy-amine/polyamide) AND table-read = only 2 series (asperti2024, zhu2022) -> the >=3 bar is NOT met, corrosion stays bench-gated. BUT real cited evidence now QUANTIFIES the design rules: (1) ramesh2012 PVC 10-50% is MONOTONIC (lower PVC = better barrier), directly supporting the low-PVC/Lambda-below-CPVC design and the government F160's resin-rich (PVC~8%) choice; (2) asperti2024 + zhu2022 show barrier improves only UP TO an optimum then DEGRADES (over-loading -> aggregation) -- so 'more filler' is NOT better. cai2021 is in-class epoxy-polyamide but only a 2-level comparison. Two on-topic mica/MIO content ladders are paywalled (named, unused).

pre_registered_rank.metric: transparent barrier index (design-rule encoding, NOT a fit)
pre_registered_rank.key_falsifiable_bet: Enhanced-65 (PVC ~11, zinc phosphate) OUT-BARRIERS Envelope-65 (lower PVC, no inhibitor) -- the OPPOSITE of a 'lower-PVC-is-better' heuristic; if the bench shows the lower-PVC track wins, the engine is FALSIFIED.

decision_rule.primary: PASS only if the measured immersion rank has Kendall tau >= 0.5 with the LOCKED rank AND a strictly higher tau than BOTH hostile nulls (solids-only, PVC-only).
decision_rule.key_pairwise: the Enhanced-65 > Envelope-65 non-obvious call must hold in the measured data (the single most decisive, PVC-contrarian bet).
decision_rule.tie_rule: two tracks are TIED if their |Z|@0.01Hz overlap within replicate scatter (6 panels/track/arm default if budget allows; 3 panels/track/arm minimum floor); ties are excluded from tau, not narrated as agreement.
decision_rule.third_party_hold: this locked rank + rule is registered with a third party BEFORE any panels are cut; the team may not re-demote-to-survive.
decision_rule.power_caveat: n=4 rank has low power; the decisive, adequately-powered test is the key pairwise bet above, not the full 4-item correlation -- stated honestly, not oversold.

pre_registered_rank.falsification: The bench (B117 comparative screen + D5894 + D870 + 60-90 d immersion/ISO 16773 EIS, ONE protocol, all tracks side-by-side, 6 panels/track/arm default and >=3 minimum floor) measures the true rank. The engine demonstrates value ONLY if it satisfies the decision rule above -- beating BOTH obvious nulls, not a strawman slash sheet. If not, the claim is honestly disproven.
pre_registered_rank.honesty: The zinc-phosphate track's barrier effect is genuinely UNCERTAIN (non-monotonic literature): that uncertainty is exactly why the Enhanced-65>Envelope-65 bet is falsifiable and not tautological. No cross-study pooling is performed (invalid).

barrier_directional.fail_closed_action: corrosion is decided by the bench (B117/D5894/EIS/immersion) across all tracks under ONE protocol
barrier_directional.notes: Directional agreement on content-ladder studies: 3/9 (cai2021 N/A, a 2-level modification axis). Cross-study EIS is NON-COMPARABLE, so NO pooled statistic is computed (the hostile-critic point, adopted). The engine's non-obvious, falsifiable output is the pre-registered track rank: Lineage-60 > Enhanced-65 > CRO-Robust-65 > Envelope-65. The bench falsifies it.
